How far can a
village boy reach?

The world opened up.

From a remote farming village to the ends of the Earth, and still going…

Going where the answer leads.

Across disciplines, oceans and the ice.

The questions got bigger.

So did the willingness to follow them.

Still reaching.
Still rooted.

Raised to aim high and look after others.

From the Delta to the Poles. And…
